cards.front: Complete the rule: Careless driving or certain law violations can lead…
cards.back: Careless driving or certain law violations can lead to suspension, cancellation or revocation even before a person has received a license.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Idaho maintains crash and moving-violation records, including out-of-state…
cards.back: Idaho maintains crash and moving-violation records, including out-of-state events, for people who have never received a license as well as licensed drivers.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook identifies Idaho as a Driver License…
cards.back: The handbook identifies Idaho as a Driver License Compact member and describes the compact as promoting compliance across member states.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Under the described compact, serious offenses and minor…
cards.back: Under the described compact, serious offenses and minor moving violations go to the driver's home state for treatment as a home-state violation.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A licensed Idaho driver's out-of-state traffic conviction is…
cards.back: A licensed Idaho driver's out-of-state traffic conviction is added to the Idaho record, with suspension if the offense is suspendable.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook's moving-violation point scale assigns…
cards.back: The handbook's moving-violation point scale assigns one through four points per recorded violation.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The point table lists a warning letter for…
cards.back: The point table lists a warning letter for eight through eleven points within any twelve months.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The point table lists a thirty-day suspension for…
cards.back: The point table lists a thirty-day suspension for twelve through seventeen points within any twelve months.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The point table lists a ninety-day suspension for…
cards.back: The point table lists a ninety-day suspension for eighteen through twenty-three points within any twenty-four months.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The point table lists a six-month suspension for…
cards.back: The point table lists a six-month suspension for at least twenty-four points within any thirty-six months.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook permits point removal once in three…
cards.back: The handbook permits point removal once in three years through an approved defensive-driving course or the described law-enforcement traffic course.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Those point-removal courses reduce points but do…
cards.back: Those point-removal courses reduce points but do not remove the conviction from the driving record.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Completing an ITD-approved defensive-driving course can remove at…
cards.back: Completing an ITD-approved defensive-driving course can remove at most three points, and the points must already be recorded before the course is completed.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook authorizes courts and the department to…
cards.back: The handbook authorizes courts and the department to impose several license actions for listed convictions; its list is not exhaustive.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Driving under the influence, using a vehicle for…
cards.back: Driving under the influence, using a vehicle for a felony and reckless driving appear among the listed license-action grounds.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Leaving an involved crash with property damage, injury…
cards.back: Leaving an involved crash with property damage, injury or death appears among the listed license-action grounds.

cards.front: Complete the rule: False oral or written statements under oath…
cards.back: False oral or written statements under oath to the department are a listed license-action ground.

cards.front: Complete the rule: An unpaid crash-damages judgment, an evidentiary-test failure or…
cards.back: An unpaid crash-damages judgment, an evidentiary-test failure or refusal, and fleeing an officer appear among the listed grounds.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Unlawful license or identification-card use, lack of required…
cards.back: Unlawful license or identification-card use, lack of required vehicle insurance and violating a license restriction appear among the listed grounds.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The source also lists school-compliance failures, unpaid child…
cards.back: The source also lists school-compliance failures, unpaid child support, visitation noncompliance and failure to obey a paternity-suit subpoena.

decks.module: Keep GDL and ALS conditions distinct

cards.front: Complete the rule: For drivers younger than seventeen, the first…
cards.back: For drivers younger than seventeen, the first moving-violation conviction brings the handbook's warning letter.
cards.memory_hook: Keep GDL and ALS conditions distinct

cards.front: Complete the rule: For drivers younger than seventeen, a second…
cards.back: For drivers younger than seventeen, a second moving-violation conviction carries a thirty-day driving suspension.
cards.memory_hook: Keep GDL and ALS conditions distinct

cards.front: Complete the rule: For drivers younger than seventeen, a third…
cards.back: For drivers younger than seventeen, a third or later moving-violation conviction carries a sixty-day suspension.
cards.memory_hook: Keep GDL and ALS conditions distinct

cards.front: Complete the rule: The described GDL penalties are additional to supervised-instruction…
cards.back: The described GDL penalties are additional to supervised-instruction permit cancellation or other court or department suspensions.
cards.memory_hook: Keep GDL and ALS conditions distinct

cards.front: Complete the rule: The GDL penalty periods are absolute and…
cards.back: The GDL penalty periods are absolute and allow no driving privileges of any kind.
cards.memory_hook: Keep GDL and ALS conditions distinct

cards.front: Complete the rule: After a DUI arrest and an evidentiary result…
cards.back: After a DUI arrest and an evidentiary result over the legal alcohol limit, an officer serves an immediate suspension notice; a notice may instead be sent after blood or urine results establish the described intoxication.
cards.memory_hook: Keep GDL and ALS conditions distinct

cards.front: Complete the rule: The described ALS is an administrative suspension imposed…
cards.back: The described ALS is an administrative suspension imposed by the transportation department under the cited alcohol-test law.
cards.memory_hook: Keep GDL and ALS conditions distinct

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook allows an ALS hearing request within…
cards.back: The handbook allows an ALS hearing request within seven days of the date written on the suspension notice, before a department-designated hearing officer.
cards.memory_hook: Keep GDL and ALS conditions distinct

cards.front: Complete the rule: An ALS is a civil sanction separate from…
cards.back: An ALS is a civil sanction separate from criminal court penalties; its requirements do not remove the duty to attend the scheduled DUI court appearance.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook makes the suspension notice effective thirty…
cards.back: The handbook makes the suspension notice effective thirty days after service, meaning receipt of the notice.

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a first evidentiary-test failure, the handbook gives…
cards.back: For a first evidentiary-test failure, the handbook gives a ninety-day suspension with no driving during its first thirty days.

cards.front: Complete the rule: After that first-failure suspension ends, the source requires…
cards.back: After that first-failure suspension ends, the source requires an ignition interlock on any vehicle driven for one year.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A second evidentiary-test failure within five years…
cards.back: A second evidentiary-test failure within five years carries a one-year suspension allowing no driving privileges.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook's implied-consent description covers a person driving…
cards.back: The handbook's implied-consent description covers a person driving or physically controlling a vehicle when suspected of impaired driving, for an alcohol or drug test under the stated law.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Refusing an officer-requested evidentiary test subjects the person…
cards.back: Refusing an officer-requested evidentiary test subjects the person to the described suspension and a two-hundred-fifty-dollar civil penalty.

cards.front: Complete the rule: For the described first refusal, an officer issues…
cards.back: For the described first refusal, an officer issues a notice and a court's upholding the findings leads to a one-year absolute suspension.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A second test refusal within ten years brings…
cards.back: A second test refusal within ten years brings a two-year absolute suspension in addition to any DUI-conviction penalty.

decks.module: Recognize conditional permits and interlock rules

cards.front: Complete the rule: A person with a suspended Idaho license may…
cards.back: A person with a suspended Idaho license may qualify for a restricted permit for travel such as work or medical treatment.
cards.memory_hook: Recognize conditional permits and interlock rules

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a department suspension, apply to the department…
cards.back: For a department suspension, apply to the department in Boise for the described restricted permit; for a court suspension, apply to the convicting court.
cards.memory_hook: Recognize conditional permits and interlock rules

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook says interlocks are mandatory after administrative…
cards.back: The handbook says interlocks are mandatory after administrative suspensions end; a DUI conviction also requires an interlock in any driven vehicle unless the court orders otherwise.
cards.memory_hook: Recognize conditional permits and interlock rules

cards.front: Complete the rule: An ignition interlock requires a starting breath sample…
cards.back: An ignition interlock requires a starting breath sample and prevents engine start when alcohol reaches or exceeds its preset level.
cards.memory_hook: Recognize conditional permits and interlock rules

cards.front: Complete the rule: The driver pays interlock installation…
cards.back: The driver pays interlock installation, maintenance and recurring monthly charges.
cards.memory_hook: Recognize conditional permits and interlock rules

decks.module: Treat reinstatement as a conditional process

cards.front: Complete the rule: After a suspension or revocation period ends, the…
cards.back: After a suspension or revocation period ends, the handbook describes applying to the department for restoration of privileges.
cards.memory_hook: Treat reinstatement as a conditional process

cards.front: Complete the rule: The printed reinstatement-fee range is twenty-five through two…
cards.back: The printed reinstatement-fee range is twenty-five through two hundred eighty-five dollars depending on the suspension; multiple suspensions may require multiple fees.
cards.memory_hook: Treat reinstatement as a conditional process
